'''Elemental separators''' were used in [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. The [[Imperial mining complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]] was equipped with elemental separators that helped the facility mine [[alantium]] ore.<ref name="Freedom">{{WEGCite|story=The Heat of Freedom|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
